x: Rather naturally there were new names in our team in Vic Blowfield, George Lucas, Stan Eales, Eric Herbert and Albert Frost. It is interesting to note that of our ten runners, six were past or future Internationals.
The two miles team race is easily won by the Bels. with a team of Bill Lucas (no. 31), Chas. Walker (30) and Eric Herbert (42).
Our condolences go to Gwynne and to his brother Eric. W.E.LUCAS and G.S.DOUBLEDAY, with warmest thanks to Eric Herbert for providing some of the above information.

Early in April a 27 strong field tackled the 5 mile road run where experience, in the shape of Arthur Penny, triumphed over men who were to make their names over the coming years – Lucas, Len and Eric Herbert, and one who became “Mr Athletics” himself, Les Cohen.
